description: Derived from AGSC-03-23, near miss: a self-`requires` is the cycle error AGSC-E302 (AGSC-03-07) and a self-`broader` on a cluster is the cycle error AGSC-E303 (AGSC-03-08), and neither also raises AGSC-E313. Item `r` requires itself, cluster `k` names itself as its broader; `f` relates to `r` and lists `k` so that neither is an orphan. The two cycle errors are the only findings, so the list of warnings is empty.
